title: Throughput Packability Index and Resize Playbook
creator: Avery Chen
description:
Problem: Customers with Dedicated fleets often over-provision to meet throughput guarantees, but lack fine-grained guidance that ties tenant-level usage patterns to actionable fleet resizes. Current reports show utilization and average CPU/GPU percentages but do not surface how well workloads pack into slabs or the cost impact of different autoscale policies.

Goal: Create a lightweight metric (Packability Index) and a playbook that converts telemetry into deterministic resize suggestions and autoscaling policy templates. The output should be a) per-pool Packability Index (0-100), b) top-5 tenant anti-patterns that drive waste, and c) concrete resize + autoscale actions (shrink/grow slab counts, change min/max replica, change burst buffer) with estimated monthly cost delta and SLO impact.

Scope: Pool-level and tenant-level analysis for Dedicated GPU pools supporting inference; integrate with Console recommendations UI, and produce an exportable CSV/report for account teams. Short-term scope excludes automated commit changes (manual apply only).

Data sources: slot-level allocation logs, request QPS and latency traces, batch size distributions, KV cache hit rates, historical autoscaler events, billing meter.

Proposed solution: 1) Define Packability Index (PI) = weighted score combining median slot utilization, variance of per-tenant peak concurrency, and fraction of partial-slab waste. 2) Implement a hygiene pipeline: ingest last-90-days telemetry, compute PI and per-tenant waste attribution, and run a simulated reshuffle engine that estimates SLO risk under candidate resize actions. 3) Surface recommendations in Console with confidence bands and a one-click download for the playbook. 4) Provide autoscale policy templates (balanced, latency-first, cost-first) with estimated cost/latency tradeoffs.

Deliverables: telemetry job (airflow/k8s cron), PI calculator microservice, simulation harness, Console recommendations card, docs/playbook for SEs, and a CSV export.

Non-goals: automated resizing, commit-level billing changes, or changes to on-call runbooks in this iteration.
acceptance_criteria: Packability Index computed daily for all Dedicated pools and backfilled 90 days
Console shows per-pool PI and top-3 tenant waste contributors
Recommendation card provides at least two resize options with estimated monthly cost delta and SLO risk level
Exportable playbook CSV available and matches simulation outputs within 5%
E2E test covering telemetry->PI->recommendation pipeline added to CI
tasks: Design PI formula and edge-case handling (Avery/Samir)
Implement telemetry ETL and aggregation job (ENG infra)
Build simulation/reshuffle engine and cost estimator (Serving team)
Create autoscale policy templates and mapping logic (Runtime)
Instrument metrics and alerts for data quality regressions
Write runbook and customer-facing playbook doc
metrics: PI coverage: percent of pools with PI computed (target 100%)
Average cost delta accuracy vs billing (target within 7%)
Recommendation adoption: percent of customers who download playbook (target 20% in 90 days)
Post-recommendation utilization uplift for adopters (target +12% median)
